reason: I'd probably connect my account since the launch month is free, but I already send a rate card and invoice brands myself, so I'm not paying for a pass until this gets me a paid collab and not another free-coffee-for-a-reel deal. At my follower count most local cafés on there will just offer food.
objection: Local cafés pay in food, not money. A list of 'best fit' businesses doesn't help me if they're all barter, and a beta with a small team in one city may not have enough brands with real budgets.
would_change_my_mind: Landing one cash collab at my rate-card price through Mitra in the free month, or seeing upfront which listed businesses actually pay cash and how much.
